methodology.summary: Biotech and life-sciences names with positive revenue or well-funded pipelines; the quality screen reduces the weakest balance sheets.
paragraphs: Longevity & Biotechnology is constructed only from the existing Stockmonk US coverage universe. Intended investment horizon: 3-5 years. Every selected company passed the strategy's sector, size, liquidity and score-coverage screens.

Eligible US-listed companies are ranked with the Stockmonk four-factor scores: Growth 35% · Quality 25% · Valuation 15% · Technical 25%. Biotech and life-sciences names with positive revenue or well-funded pipelines; the quality screen reduces the weakest balance sheets. Theme membership is a curated list of 17 US-listed companies with direct exposure to the theme. The engine verifies every selected ticker against the coverage universe and does not fill the basket with unrelated sector names. The highest-ranked names are selected subject to a 9% single-stock cap and a 90% sector guide. Weights use score-proportional sizing. The portfolio is reviewed quarterly.

No ETF, mutual fund or non-US-listed security is eligible. Missing data is not filled with an estimate. A company without a full research report remains eligible only where the quantitative strategy calls for it, and its constituent card links to score evidence rather than a research report.
The performance shown is a current-constituent simulation, not a live track record. Rebalancing proposals are generated from the same rules and remain proposed until a future review is executed.
selectionCriteria: Curated theme membership (17 eligible US-listed companies)
